concepts.name: Turnul în l
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a refined minimalist logo for the Romanian civic monitoring site "lastraja.ro". The name refers literally to keeping watch: a soldier / sentry guarding from a watchtower. THE SOLDIER INSIDE THE WATCHTOWER IS ESSENTIAL, and the watchtower must be built into the typography itself.
CONCEPT A — THE INITIAL L IS THE TOWER.
Exact wordmark: "lastraja.ro", all lowercase, no spaces, spelled l a s t r a j a . r o. Design a clean confident lowercase humanist sans-serif wordmark. Transform the initial lowercase "l" into a narrow architectural watchtower while retaining its readable upright stroke and small baseline foot. The tower should rise modestly above the other letters. Its top is a simple square battlement / lookout platform, NOT a pointed fantasy castle. Within the open lookout at the top, visibly include one tiny helmeted soldier standing guard: clear head, shoulders and upper torso, an upright slender spear at his side. He is inside the tower, looking outward from the lookout. Use a clever silhouette or negative-space treatment so the guard remains clearly visible; do not reduce him to an ambiguous dot. His posture is calm and watchful. Keep the architecture extremely economical: one shaft, one lookout opening, three top merlons maximum. The tower's base flows naturally into the initial letter and the following "a".
Single black ink on a plain light background, flat vector-like shapes, crisp edges, no shading. Landscape canvas, one centered horizontal logo with ample whitespace, large enough to judge the small sentry.
Make a sophisticated civic brand, not a game logo. The remaining letters must be impeccably kerned and highly legible. Only this one finished wordmark. No standalone icon to the left, no extra text, slogan, labels, mockups, shadows, gradient, shields, flags or eye symbol.

concepts.name: Turnul în t
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Design an exceptionally polished minimalist integrated wordmark for "lastraja.ro", a Romanian site keeping watch on Parliament and politicians. The concept must literally contain a soldier keeping watch from a watchtower, with the tower part of the actual text.
CONCEPT B — A WATCHTOWER HIDDEN IN THE LETTER T.
Exact text, verbatim: "lastraja.ro", lowercase, no spaces, l a s t r a j a . r o.
Use a compact modern geometric slab-serif / sturdy architectural lowercase wordmark, friendly but authoritative. The "t" in "lastraja.ro" is the watchtower: its vertical stem is the tower shaft, and its horizontal crossbar becomes the floor of an open rectangular lookout balcony. Above that balcony is a very simple flat battlement roof. A tiny clearly recognizable medieval sentry stands INSIDE that top lookout opening: helmeted head, shoulders, torso and a slim upright spear. The head and body must be visible using clean white negative space within the dark tower opening or dark silhouette in a white aperture. Minimal, no facial details. The guard peers out vigilantly. The t must remain a legible t, with the other letters at normal proportions; do not replace a letter with a separate pictogram. Integrate the watchtower seamlessly between "las" and "raja.ro", on the same baseline. The t's tower can extend a little above the ascenders, but must stay proportional to the typography.
One flat dark ink color on a clean light ground. A single centered horizontal logo on a landscape canvas, generous clear space, crisp vector-like finish. Professional European civic identity, clever typographic integration, no texture.
Mandatory: soldier visible inside a watchtower, tower integrated into the t, exact legible domain. No standalone icon, no giant castle, no extra words, no concept labels, no badge, no eye, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no website mockup.

concepts.name: Turnul în j
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a beautiful spare editorial logo for the independent Romanian parliamentary watchdog "lastraja.ro". "Strajă" means sentry / guard / keeping watch. The user's required visual is a SOLDIER INSIDE A WATCHTOWER integrated into the lettering, not an icon next to the name.
CONCEPT C — THE J AS A SENTRY TOWER.
Exact wordmark, verbatim: "lastraja.ro", l a s t r a j a . r o, lowercase, no spaces.
Use distinctive contemporary editorial serif lettering with medium weight, beautiful optical spacing, elegant controlled contrasts and excellent legibility. Transform the letter "j" in "lastraja.ro" into a very slim watchtower. Preserve the j's characteristic curved descender clearly below the baseline, so the word still reads naturally. Above its vertical stem, the j's dot area becomes a tiny open squared lookout at modest ascender height: two simple vertical posts and a straight canopy / parapet, housing a visibly recognizable helmeted soldier with head, shoulders and upper torso. Show the sentry standing inside this opening keeping watch, one slim vertical spear beside him. The silhouette should use just a handful of confident shapes. Soldier must be big enough within the lookout to read as a person, not a decorative dot. The tower is literally the j, and its descending hook ties it back into the wordmark. No separate pictogram. Keep everything balanced and airy; the watchtower is a subtle memorable discovery in an otherwise restrained logotype.
Single black ink on plain warm-white background, flat solid vector-like artwork. Landscape canvas, one large centered horizontal logo, ample whitespace.
Minimal civic-publication aesthetic. No illustration around the logo, no castle landscape, no full heraldic crest, no eye, no flags, no ornamental flourishes beyond the typography, no slogan, no labels, no interface mockup, no gradients, shadows or 3D. Exact correct text and a soldier IN the tower are essential.
